scoring_justification: The CNT formulas and input parameters are public and deterministic; the checker compares the agent's computed critical radius and free energy to the known paper-reported values (embedding them as hidden gold) with absolute tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Target values for critical radius and free energy at 673 K and 923 K as reported in the paper (Supplementary Table 6).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Nature Communications 2020, doi:10.1038/s41467-020-15934-1, Supplementary Table 6 and Fig. 6
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's supplementary table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values the paper reports for these conditions; they serve as the expected answer for the CNT calculation.

outputs.description: Critical nucleus radius and free-energy barrier at 673 K and 923 K computed from classical nucleation theory with the provided parameters.

output_contract.notes: All necessary constants (γ, V_m, S, R) are given in the instruction. The checker will compare these deterministic computed values against the paper's reported results using appropriate tolerances.
